# CarbonDot Context
- Overview: CarbonDot converts industrial flue gas CO2 into stable calcium carbonate mineral granules using ambient biocatalytic mineralization.
- Energy: 40% lower energy penalty than conventional capture / DAC.
- Funding: Raised $2.5M Seed round led by Planet Ventures. Valuation is confidential.
- Pilot: Commercial pilot operating live in Rotterdam capturing 1,200 tons/yr. 3 paid enterprise pilot MOUs in place.
- Technology: BioGranule modular 40-foot skids that bolt onto exhaust stacks. Enzyme runs at ambient temperatures to crystallize raw CO2 into ASTM C33 certified building aggregates for concrete.
- Founders: Founded in 2024 by Dr. Aris Thorne (CEO, ex-TU Delft) and Maya Lin (CTO, ex-Climeworks). Head of Deployment is Raj Patel.
